text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Ardan's debut right around
the
corner, we've begun our final
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My debut is already in view... and I can't
afford to
waste a single second.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...The closer we get to the big day, the
more
fiercely determined Mejiro Ardan
gets. The fire in
her eyes has become a
raging inferno.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, may I do another?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wish to run as much as I possibly can
while I still
feel capable of improving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you. If you'll excuse me, then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may look like she's pushing herself
too hard,
but pouring water on those
flames now could cool
her momentum.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Which means the best thing I can do is
keep that
fire burning until the race, so
she can place as
high as possible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: HYAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's determination remains
sky-high,
and she pushes herself until
the last possible
moment before her
debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's race day—and time for Mejiro
Ardan's debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sheer depth of her concentration
leaves me
speechless. Countless seconds
tick by as I gaze
away, entranced by her
aura...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My mind and body are set. I can run

whenever I must.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your continued efforts in

preparing me for this day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall race, and I shall show them all that I am in this moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now then... I'll be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you hear? That girl making her debut today is the younger sister of the Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about that? Boy, that Mejiro
Ramonu...
I still remember it now, the
way she'd fly down the
track.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She's a living legend, for sure. I'll never
forget
how she ran at the Japanese
Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...We're at the racecourse. This isn't the

academy's running area—it's the real
deal. The
sensations, the smells, the
wind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(My heart is pounding, and I have pins
and
needles from head to toe. Try as I
might, I can't
suppress my feelings!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I must channel this energy into light, so
that I may
leave a brilliant trail in my
wake.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall run with all I have.
